title: af/task-evaluation@1 payload
description: Referenced by EvaluationCompleted@1: the independent evaluator's parsed verdict over the derived Snapshot. Only the typed verdict is recorded here; the evaluator's raw output stays in its worker evidence.

schema.description: Marker the current writer always emits. Not required: `af` v0.7.1 wrote `verdict` and `summary` alone, and those rows are still in Task state.
